quest.title: Beverage Shop on the Pier
quest.description: Quqing, the owner of the new beverage shop on the northern pier of Liyue Harbor, seems to be asking for help...

dialogues.speaker: Quqing
dialogues.text: Welcome! What would you two like to drink?

dialogues.speaker: Quqing
dialogues.text: Hmm... judging by how you guys are dressed, I'm guessing you're not from around here. I don't know if the tea I've got here is suited to your tastes...

dialogues.speaker: Quqing
dialogues.text: I'll start you guys off with a pot of Yunlai White Tea. If that's not to your liking, you can come back later. I should be able to get someone to pick up a batch of specialty drinks from Mondstadt's Weinlesefest...

choices.text: Thanks, but we're not here to drink.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! We're reliable errand runners! Paimon heard you put up a commission at the Weinlesefest asking for someone who knows what they're doing to help with ordering drinks, so that's where we come in!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you want to place an order for any drinks, let us know, and we'll take the order for you!

response.speaker: Quqing
response.text: You guys came all the way to Liyue to take orders for clients? You guys are so sweet!

response.speaker: Quqing
response.text: I was afraid no one would accept such a troublesome commission... I'll leave it to you then!

response.speaker: Quqing
response.text: I've heard from sailors who have been to Mondstadt that <color=#00E1FFFF>The Cat's Tail Tavern</color>'s specialty, the "Mintberry," is refreshing as it is relaxing.

response.speaker: Quqing
response.text: So I'd like to order <color=#00E1FFFF>65 cases of Mintberries</color>, to sell to sailors together with other drinks. This way, they can stay in a good mood and work efficiently.

response.speaker: Quqing
response.text: In the past, the merchants in Mondstadt would also prepare designated equivalents according to my needs. In accordance with the rules of the Weinlesefest, I've gathered some Fairbrew Jelly in advance, and I'm giving it all to you!

response.speaker: Quqing
response.text: The funds I've set aside are a rough estimate, and please keep the change as reward for your hard work. Although this is not enough to fully express my gratitude...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Don't worry. It's 65 cases of Mintberries, right? Leave the order to Paimon and {NICKNAME}. Handling errands is our specialty!

choices.text: We're errand runners who help with ordering drinks.

talks.objective: Return to Springvale and place an order with Diane

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: Welcome to The Cat's Tail! What can I get you guys?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, Diane. We've got a business proposition for you!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain Quqing's order request to Diane.

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: Oh? The beverage shop on Liyue's north pier that just opened?

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: The sailors from Dornman Port have spoken about the shopkeeper, and Margaret seems to have sourced ingredients from her before.

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: Recently, when Quqing was selling thirst-quenching drinks to sailors at the dock, she also asked them to promote Qingce Village's spring water.

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: She gets water at a high price from Qingce Village and resells it where there is demand, only earning the basic cost of individual labor.

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: With her help, people from other places can brew wine with a unique flavor using the spring water of Qingce Village, and it provides a source of income for the elderly folk in the village. It's two birds killed with one stone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So that's how the story goes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Quqing is such a nice person!

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: Yup. Perhaps The Cat's Tail will be a long-term partner with her.

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's talk shop. How much are you going to pay for all these Mintberries?

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: Well, the deal is done!

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: As for the delivery... leave that to the sailors of Dornman Port. They'll ship it directly to Liyue's north pier.

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: This document is for you. Please give it to Quqing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thank you very much, Diane!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Great success! Let's report back to Quqing, {NICKNAME}.

talks.objective: Go to Liyue Harbor and respond to Quqing's request

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Quqing, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've placed an order for the drinks you need. It'll be loaded on the boats tomorrow and it'll be sent to the docks as soon as possible! Please take this receipt!

dialogues.speaker: Quqing
dialogues.text: That's it? Wow, you guys move fast!

dialogues.speaker: Quqing
dialogues.text: I...I... I'll prepare you a pot of tea with the best spring water...

choices.text: No need to be so generous.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes, yes. We have other people to help order for. There's no need for you to serve us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All the best with your business! Next time we'll come to your place for a nice drink!

response.speaker: Quqing
response.text: Ah... Well, next time I'll be sure to make your favorite drink!

choices.text: We've taken payment for our work already.

dialogues.speaker: Quqing
dialogues.text: Thank you very much for the order.

dialogues.speaker: Quqing
dialogues.text: With this batch of specialty drinks, sailors can quench their thirst with a different taste.

response.speaker: Quqing
response.text: Sailors have different preferences. Some prefer light tea, others prefer sweet and sour juice... If you drink the same thing all the time, you'll get bored of it.

response.speaker: Quqing
response.text: So I always restock the store with drinks of different flavors, trying to meet the sailors' needs as much as possible...

response.speaker: Quqing
response.text: Because the sailors did me a great service, I just recently set up shop on this side of the pier, serving drinks to the sailors.

response.speaker: Quqing
response.text: But I'm not exactly the best businesswoman, and business has been rather slow...

response.speaker: Quqing
response.text: Bye! All the best with your journey!

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: Eh... You guys are joking, right? At the end of the day, we're still a business. Please be reasonable.

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: Sorry, this price is still too low. Margaret is going to get me some heat if she hears about this...

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: I think that's a good price! You've got yourself a deal!

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: Well, even though we will take a small loss on this transaction, considering that the goods are for Miss Quqing, this won't be an issue.

dialogues.speaker: Diane
dialogues.text: If you keep nagging me with such absurd prices, I will lose my patience. Why don't we settle the deal at the standard rate set by Margaret?
